Class Experience

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.Experience
public class Experience extends Object

Title: Experience Class

Description: This Experience class represents an experience entity in the system. It is a helper for the lessonLearned class

  • Constructor Details

    • Experience

      public Experience()

      Method: Experience()

      Description: This default constructor is not used in this system.

    • Experience

      public Experience(int experienceId, int lessonId, String author, double timeSpentHours, String whatWasDone, String howItWasDone, String teamEffort)

      Method: Experience(int experienceId, int lessonId, String author, double timeSpentHours, String whatWasDone, String howItWasDone, String teamEffort)

      Description: This constructor is used to establish experience entity objects.

      Parameters:
      experienceId - specifies the unique ID number of this experience
      lessonId - specifies the unique ID number of the lesson this experience is associated with
      author - specifies the creator of this experience
      timeSpentHours - specifies how long the experience took
      whatWasDone - specifies the user's explanation of what was done in the experience
      howItWasDone - specifies the user's explanation of how the experience was completed
      teamEffort - specifies the user's explanation of the effort the team expended

      public boolean setTimeSpentHours(double timeSpentHours)

      protected void setIndex(int newIndex)
